mapper.select: SELECT ap.id, ap.acceptance_id, t.id AS task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.publisher_id, ap.appellant_id, ap.appeal_type, ap.reason, ap.evidence_images AS evidence_images_json, ap.status, ap.result, ap.handler_id, ap.handle_remark, ap.handled_at, ap.created_at, CASE WHEN ap.appeal_type = 1 THEN t.publisher_id ELSE a.acceptor_id END AS respondent_id FROM task_appeal ap INNER JOIN task_acceptance a ON ap.acceptance_id = a.id INNER JOIN task t ON a.task_id = t.id WHERE ap.id = #{id} AND ap.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handled, SUM(CASE WHEN appeal_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptorAppeal, SUM(CASE WHEN appeal_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publisherAppeal FROM task_appeal WHERE deleted = 0
